article.title: A Pakistani view on the economics of Obama’s reelection
article.excerpt: I am not endorsing this political and economic analysis, merely reporting it: Many Pakistanis fear President Barack Obama’s re-election will mean a surge in America’s unpopular drone campaign, but for those making and selling US flags to burn at protests this could be good news.
